## Appearance

Marilla is a tall, thin woman with a spare, gaunt form defined by angles rather than curves. She has faded, sallow cheeks, a lined face, and dark hair streaked with gray that is worn twisted into a hard little knot at the back. At times, she displays hard, work-worn hands and can appear old, worn, and tired.

## Personality

A middle-aged woman of rigid conscience and sober step, Marilla Cuthbert is characteristically stern, practical, and sensible. She is undemonstrative and repressed by nature, viewing open displays of deep emotion as unseemly and often feeling reluctant to show any emotional weakness. When communicating with children, she is prone to being crisp and curt, strongly favoring moral lessons and regularly admonishing poor table manners. Despite her strictness, she harbors extreme pride in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), whom she resolves to educate well so the girl is fitted to earn her own living. Marilla is also known for specific domestic skills, such as making round, braided mats and brewing celebrated homemade currant wine.

## History

Marilla Cuthbert lived at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for sixty years, having spent a cramped childhood in which she kept still when told to and harbored hidden dreams [F3, F4, F5]. In her youth, she refused to forgive John [Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) after a quarrel, a decision that left her with lingering regret [F1]. Desiring help on the farm, Marilla and her brother [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) set out to adopt an orphan boy, but they were shocked when a girl named [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) arrived instead [S1, S3]. Though Marilla initially insisted on returning [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), her pity for the girl's past led her to keep and raise her [S5, S6]. Over the years, Marilla strictly educated [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), guided her through childhood misadventures, and privately grew deeply fond of her [S7, S9, S10, S28]. She supported Anne's academic ambitions at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), but after [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) suddenly died and her own failing sight threatened [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), Marilla was saved from selling the property when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) chose to stay home and teach [S37, S44, S45]. To enable [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to attend college later, Marilla took in her sick relative's twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md), and invited [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to live with them [S53, S54, S74]. Years later, after raising [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and helping her prepare for marriage to John Blythe's son [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), Marilla saw [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) off to her new home [F6, S88, S89]. Marilla eventually traveled to [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds) to celebrate [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), marking the first time in her life she ate a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) dinner away from [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) [F8, S90].

## Quotes

> "I’d never dream of taking a girl to bring up. I wonder at Mrs. Alexander Spencer for doing it. But there, she wouldn’t shrink from adopting a whole orphan asylum if she took it into her head."
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P29](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0029)

> "I don’t feel as if I wanted any more children to look after than I’ve got at present. You’re problem enough in all conscience. What’s to be done with you I don’t know. Matthew is a most ridiculous man."
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P25](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0025)

> “There, there, Marilla, you can have your own way,” said Matthew reassuringly. “Only be as good and kind to her as you can without spoiling her. I kind of think she’s one of the sort you can do anything with if you only get her to love you.”
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P35](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0035)

> "Matthew Cuthbert, I’m astonished at you. You know that Anne’s behavior was dreadful, and yet you take her part! I suppose you’ll be saying next thing that she oughtn’t to be punished at all!"
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P2](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0002)

> "She’ll have her meals regular, and I’ll carry them up to her myself. But she’ll stay up there until she’s willing to apologize to Mrs. Lynde, and that’s final, Matthew."
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P4](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0004)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--marilla-cuthbert.md)

Marilla acts as a mentor and dear friend to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), letting her stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) after initially being shocked that an orphan girl was sent instead of a boy. Though Marilla originally intended to send [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back, she hesitates after seeing her distress and resolves to keep and educate her properly. Their relationship grows into a deep bond, with Marilla offering affection and discipline while guiding [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) through her upbringing.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P8](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P39](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0039), +21 more_

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--rachel-lynde.md)

Marilla and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) are neighboring friends who frequently visit each other for tea. Though [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) often voices strong opinions and unsolicited advice, such as disapproving of the initial adoption idea or counseling Marilla on Anne's behavior, Marilla trusts her perspective. They maintain a close community connection, attending social events together and supporting one another in times of need.

### [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--marilla-cuthbert.md)

Marilla serves as Davy's guardian, issuing orders and enforcing discipline to manage his unruly and mischievous nature. Despite being frequently tested by his pranks, lies, and antics, she works alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to punish his misbehavior while holding a genuine fondness for him.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), +11 more_
